senses.gloss: ण्युट् krt affix अन in the sense of ' skilled agent ' applied (1) to the root गै to sing. e.g. गायनः, गायनी, cf. Kas. on P. III 1.147, also गाथकः, गाथिका by P. III. 1.146: (2) to the root हा (III. P. and III.A. also) if ' rice ' or ' time ' be the sense conveyed: e. g. हायना व्रीहयः, हायनः संवत्सरः .cf. Kas. on P. III. 1.148.
